Redragon Flick XL Extended Gaming Mouse Pad 400x900mm

Upgrade your desktop real estate and achieve uncompromised gliding precision with the Redragon Flick XL Extended Gaming Mouse Pad (P032). Available at Turbo Computer, this massive desk-sized hardware accessory measures an expansive 400x900mm, providing a completely unified surface configuration to support both your full-sized mechanical keyboard and high-DPI gaming mouse. It stands as the definitive choice for pro-gamers and modern workstation setups across Egypt looking for an immediate hardware modification to secure stable physical tracking and protect their desktop ecosystem.

The Redragon Flick XL features an advanced silk-processed fabric surface optimized for both high-speed tracking and sharp stop-and-go control management. Engineered for heavy-duty daily performance, it comes integrated with double-stitched anti-fray edges that completely eliminate structural peeling and fraying. Outfitted with a highly resilient waterproof coating that repels accidental liquid spills and a high-density non-slip rubber base, it guarantees a stress-free and rock-solid anchor during intense gaming scenarios.
